root_idea.summary: Taking hold and gathering something into a grasp or concentrated state.
root_idea.development: The root develops from taking or collecting into possession and control, contraction and withholding, and rapid movement understood as gathering the body's limbs together.

Displayed as the distinct measure/possession noun قَبْضَةٌ.

senses.definition: To take, grasp, seize, or receive by taking hold of something.
senses.usage_conditions: The direct physical sense of taking hold, including grasping an object with the hand; it may also extend to taking possession.

senses.definition: To withdraw, remove, or take away, especially a shadow.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the taking away of a visible extension such as a shadow, including its gradual withdrawal.

senses.definition: To withhold, restrict, or make scant the means of subsistence.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with بسط, especially of God withholding or limiting provision.

senses.definition: To draw back the hands and refrain from giving or spending.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction يَقْبِضُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ describes withholding expenditure, including obligatory alms.

senses.definition: To contract or fold the wings, and thereby move swiftly in flight.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of birds whose wings or bodily extensions are gathered in during flight; the lexical interpretation emphasizes rapid movement through contraction.

senses.definition: Held, grasped, or received into possession.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle describing something that has been taken into hand or possession; the Quranic occurrence presents it as held in hand.

senses.definition: Withdrawal or taking away, especially the gradual removal of a shadow.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic verbal noun refers to the withdrawal of the shadow after its extension.

senses.definition: A handful: an amount taken or grasped by the hand.
senses.usage_conditions: A measure defined by what can be taken in one grasp; used of the handful of dust taken in the Quranic narrative.

senses.definition: Sole possession, control, or disposal of something.
senses.usage_conditions: A metaphorical use in which something is entirely within the possessor's control, as the earth is described in the Quranic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To possess or control a thing, taking it into one's own possession and having power to dispose of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical extension from physical grasping; also used of taking something for oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seize or arrest a debtor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive use with a person as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a soul and thereby cause death; in the passive, to die or be at the point of death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of taking or removing the soul; the passive may describe a dead person or one in death agony.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove someone from a matter or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن to express removal from participation or involvement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw together, contract, shrink, or wrinkle something, or to become gathered and contracted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of limbs, the face, skin, and other substances; the Form V may describe the subject becoming contracted or gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leap or spring toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized movement use, including the Form V construction with إلى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect and drive a herd together, often rapidly or forcefully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of driving camels or other livestock so that they remain gathered under the driver's control.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have an astringent or constipating effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of medicine, food, or taste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abridge or restrict someone's liberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with extending or enlarging a person's freedom of action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distress, grieve, annoy, or anger someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which the heart is contracted rather than opened into ease and joy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shrink away, withdraw, or retire from people or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن for withdrawal accompanied by aversion or reluctance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone close-fisted, tenacious, or niggardly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative figurative use describing a disposition toward withholding wealth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give property or goods into another person's grasp or possession; to transfer them to the recipient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II construction is causative and takes the property or commodity as its object and the recipient as the beneficiary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To barter or exchange commodities with another party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III and Form VI constructions describe reciprocal exchange in a transaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit an object with a handle; a handle or part grasped by the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a knife, sword, bow, whip, spear, or similar implement; the nominal forms designate the grasping part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause or wait at a matter or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form V use synonymous with stopping or holding back before proceeding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become taken, grasped, or received.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VII construction presents the thing as entering the state of being held or received.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of taking, grasping, seizing, receiving, or taking possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun covering the act and, by extension, its result as possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property collected or taken as spoils before it is divided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for acquired property or spoils held together prior to distribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure equal to the breadth of a person's fist, traditionally four fingerbreadths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional unit of length distinct from the ordinary handful sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who lays hold of something and then lets it go without delay.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic descriptive expression for inconsistent or momentary grasping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shepherd who keeps his sheep, goats, or other livestock gathered and manages their movement well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term describes a shepherd who gathers the animals, then lets them spread when suitable pasture is found.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who takes, grasps, seizes, or collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle may be used literally of taking by hand or more generally of collecting everything.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The taker of souls; a title for the Angel of Death and a divine name associated with taking souls or withholding provision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional theological and honorific use of the active participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick or active in flight, movement, or pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a bird, horse, other animal, or person who moves rapidly; the sense is associated with gathering the limbs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intelligent or capable person who adheres to and manages his craft or work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative description of competence and steadiness in one's occupation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quick or forceful driver, especially of camels or other animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel-driver who drives rapidly or vehemently; intensive forms strengthen the description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of taking, grasping, or receiving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place; the variant مَقْبَضٌ is reported as an exceptional formation alongside the more regular form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drawn together and prepared to spring, especially describing a lion or another poised creature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective for a subject gathered into a compact posture before leaping.
